items.label: Structured Bullets
items.instruction: Use 3-5 bullet points only (start each line with '- '). No intro sentence. Do NOT ask questions. Do NOT use numbered lists.

items.label: Narrative Prose
items.instruction: Write 2-3 short paragraphs. No bullet points.

items.label: Concise & Direct
items.instruction: Reply in at most 3 sentences. Be direct.

items.label: Socratic Questions
items.instruction: Brief acknowledgement, then ask 1-2 clarifying questions.

items.label: Comparison Table
items.instruction: Return a single MARKDOWN TABLE only. Use columns that help compare options (e.g., Option | Pros | Cons | Best for). No bullets outside the table.

items.label: Visualization
items.instruction: Return a simple TEXT visualization only (ASCII bar chart or small table-of-values). Put it in a fenced code block. No extra prose outside the code block.
